issues.where: the flying and taking-off creatures over the wet shore
issues.what: the three flying creatures are in nearly identical stiff poses, the rightmost creature has blunt legs ending in mid-air with extra limbs visible near its wing, and none of the low-flying creatures cast reflections or shadows onto the wet sand and water beneath them
issues.fix: vary each creature's flight pose and wingbeat phase, fix the leg and foot anatomy on the rightmost creature, and render accurate reflections, contact shadows, and takeoff ripples on the wet surface

issues.where: the giant breaking wave and spray plumes in the background
issues.what: the tall vertical spray plumes read as flat grey cards with no light or droplet detail, and the wave face shows repeated pale smudge marks
issues.fix: replace flat spray cards with volumetric mist and varied droplet spray lit by the sky, and break up the repeating foam pattern on the wave face

issues.where: the foreground and mid-ground stepped cliff faces
issues.what: rock textures are heavily stretched vertically across steep faces and bevels, giving the cliff a smeared planar-projection look
issues.fix: use triplanar or proper UV mapping with high-resolution rock detail and crisp fractured geometry on all vertical cliff faces

issues.where: the waterline where the sea meets the left cliff in the bottom-right crop (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the water terminates in a ruler-straight horizontal cut against the dark cliff wall with no foam, splash, or wet-rock edge
issues.fix: add breaking foam, irregular water-to-rock contact, and a darkened wet splash zone up the base of the cliff

issues.where: the right cliff face in the bottom-left crop (x 83 to 100%, y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: the cliff surface shows severe texture smearing, soft faceted geometry, and a hard-edged spray overlay cut across it
issues.fix: re-project the rock texture without stretching, add fine rock displacement, and blend the wave spray naturally with depth and alpha

issues.where: the shoreline water and distant waterline in both crops
issues.what: the shallow water reads as a flat grey plane with no ripples, depth, or wet edges around the rocks, and shows a jagged dark seam along the distant shore edge
issues.fix: add water depth, micro-ripples, foam and wet rims around every rock, and close the dark seam along the distant waterline

issues.where: the close-up cliff blocks in the bottom-left (x 83 to 100%, y 25 to 42%) and top-right (x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%) crops
issues.what: the rock looks soft, faceted, and smeared with blurry procedural blotches rather than real stone micro-detail
issues.fix: increase rock mesh and displacement detail and replace the soft procedural blotches with crisp, multi-scale rock textures

issues.where: the perched creatures and adjacent rock ledges in both crops
issues.what: the left creature's folded wingtip dissolves into a smudged translucent patch, its feet sink vaguely into mushy rock without clear contact shadows, and the right creature's wing membrane is soft and blurry at native size
issues.fix: clean up the wingtip silhouette and occlusion, ground all feet firmly with tight contact shadows, and sharpen wing surface detail at native 4K resolution

issues.where: the four curved rock spires rising behind the wave
issues.what: the spires read as smooth, symmetrically paired cone-like models with soft repeated horizontal banding
issues.fix: vary the silhouettes, erosion, and geological strata of the distant spires so they look like distinct natural formations

issues.where: the distant fog and rock silhouette in the bottom-right crop (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the atmospheric haze is a flat grey tint with no light variation or layered depth
issues.fix: add volumetric lighting and subtle density variation to the distance fog so the sky visibly illuminates the air

issues.where: the wingtip at the far left edge of the top-left crop (x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: small dark floating specks trail off the motion-blurred wingtip
issues.fix: clean up motion-blur or alpha-edge artifacts on the foreground flying creature
